about_the_game:
This simulator assumes you follow real-world stock markets. If you don’t follow market news and events, gameplay will be limited.

An investing game like never before

Talk is cheap. Now let’s see who can really ride the market.

This game is a satire of Wall Street and a social experiment, but also a serious test of investing skill.

At its core, it’s a virtual trading terminal with daily updates. Sharing your progress is simple, and results are verifiable.

This is the patient investor's trading game

Yes, really. Trading events occur once every trading day. If you start on a Friday evening, you will have to wait three real days for the next trading event. Building a fortune in investing takes time.

Every trading day, the prices on the Stock Exchange are updated with changes based on public developments from real markets.

You have a million dollars and decide to start your own Hedge Fund

A friendly trading terminal is at your disposal for all aspects of Fund management. You can buy, sell and short stocks. Other players can invest in your Fund and you can invest in theirs. If your Fund is open to investors, you can make even more money by earning a share of the investors' profits. Social connections must be formed outside the game.

Think the AI bubble is about to burst? Short the tech sector.

Think commercial aviation is ready to climb? Buy airlines.

See a recession on the horizon? Short the Total Market Index Fund!

Hungry for even more risk? Take out a high-interest margin loan.

Build your ideal portfolio and put it to the test against others. You can even create a shareable link to let anyone follow your progress. Share your track record with friends and family!

Choices matter

Each player controls a single Fund, and your fortune depends on it. You can close up shop and start over, but that is the last resort.

As the saying goes: Today is always the best day to start investing. So open up your trading terminal and start managing your very own Hedge Fund!
